queries.sql: CREATE TABLE `migrations` ( `id` INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, `version` VARCHAR NOT NULL, `class` VARCHAR NOT NULL, `group` VARCHAR NOT NULL, `namespace` VARCHAR NOT NULL, `time` INT NOT NULL, `batch` INT NOT NULL )

CREATE TABLE `kelas` ( `id` INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, `nama` VARCHAR NOT NULL, `tingkat` TINYINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 4, `tahun_ajaran` VARCHAR NOT NULL DEFAULT '2026/2027', `guru_id` INT NULL, `created_at` DATETIME NULL, `updated_at` DATETIME NULL )

CREATE TABLE `users` ( `id` INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, `nama` VARCHAR NOT NULL, `username` VARCHAR NOT NULL, `email` VARCHAR NULL, `password_hash` VARCHAR NOT NULL, `role` TEXT CHECK(`role` IN ('admin','guru','siswa')) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'siswa', `kelas_id` INT NULL, `avatar` VARCHAR NULL DEFAULT '🦊', `is_active` TINYINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, `created_at` DATETIME NULL, `updated_at` DATETIME NULL, CONSTRAINT `users_kelas_id_foreign` FOREIGN KEY (`kelas_id`) REFERENCES `kelas`(`id`) ON DELETE SET NULL ON UPDATE SET NULL )

CREATE TABLE `buku` ( `id` INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, `judul` VARCHAR NOT NULL, `penulis` VARCHAR NOT NULL, `penerbit` VARCHAR NULL, `genre` TEXT CHECK(`genre` IN ('Dongeng','Sains','Puisi','Cerita Rakyat','Komik','Novel Anak','Agama','Lainnya')) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Dongeng', `jumlah_halaman` INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, `warna_sampul` VARCHAR NOT NULL DEFAULT '#6C4CF1', `ikon` VARCHAR NULL DEFAULT '📚', `deskripsi` TEXT NULL, `ditambah_oleh` INT NULL, `created_at` DATETIME NULL, `updated_at` DATETIME NULL, CONSTRAINT `buku_ditambah_oleh_foreign` FOREIGN KEY (`ditambah_oleh`) REFERENCES `users`(`id`) ON DELETE SET NULL ON UPDATE SET NULL )

CREATE TABLE `jurnal_baca` ( `id` INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, `siswa_id` INT NOT NULL, `buku_id` INT NULL, `judul_buku` VARCHAR NOT NULL, `tanggal` DATE NOT NULL, `halaman_dari` INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, `halaman_sampai` INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, `jumlah_halaman` INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, `durasi_menit` INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, `ringkasan` TEXT NULL, `pesan_cerita` TEXT NULL, `rating` TINYINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 5, `perasaan` VARCHAR NULL DEFAULT '😊', `status` TEXT CHECK(`status` IN ('menunggu','terverifikasi','revisi')) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'menunggu', `catatan_guru` TEXT NULL, `diverifikasi_oleh` INT NULL, `diverifikasi_pada` DATETIME NULL, `created_at` DATETIME NULL, `updated_at` DATETIME NULL, CONSTRAINT `jurnal_baca_siswa_id_foreign` FOREIGN KEY (`siswa_id`) REFERENCES `users`(`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE, CONSTRAINT `jurnal_baca_buku_id_foreign` FOREIGN KEY (`buku_id`) REFERENCES `buku`(`id`) ON DELETE SET NULL ON UPDATE SET NULL, CONSTRAINT `jurnal_baca_diverifikasi_oleh_foreign` FOREIGN KEY (`diverifikasi_oleh`) REFERENCES `users`(`id`) ON DELETE SET NULL ON UPDATE SET NULL )

CREATE TABLE `lencana` ( `id` INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, `nama` VARCHAR NOT NULL, `deskripsi` VARCHAR NULL, `ikon` VARCHAR NOT NULL DEFAULT '🏅', `syarat_tipe` TEXT CHECK(`syarat_tipe` IN ('total_buku','total_halaman','total_menit','streak','total_jurnal')) NOT NULL, `syarat_nilai` INT NOT NULL, `created_at` DATETIME NULL, `updated_at` DATETIME NULL )

CREATE TABLE `user_lencana` ( `id` INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, `user_id` INT NOT NULL, `lencana_id` INT NOT NULL, `diraih_pada` DATETIME NULL, CONSTRAINT `user_lencana_user_id_foreign` FOREIGN KEY (`user_id`) REFERENCES `users`(`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE, CONSTRAINT `user_lencana_lencana_id_foreign` FOREIGN KEY (`lencana_id`) REFERENCES `lencana`(`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE )

timelineData.query: CREATE TABLE `buku` ( `id` INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, `judul` VARCHAR NOT NULL, `penulis` VARCHAR NOT NULL, `penerbit` VARCHAR NULL, `genre` TEXT CHECK(`genre` IN ('Dongeng','Sains','Puisi','Cerita Rakyat','Komik','Novel Anak','Agama','Lainnya')) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Dongeng', `jumlah_halaman` INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, `warna_sampul` VARCHAR NOT NULL DEFAULT '#6C4CF1', `ikon` VARCHAR NULL DEFAULT '📚', `deskripsi` TEXT NULL, `ditambah_oleh` INT NULL, `created_at` DATETIME NULL, `updated_at` DATETIME NULL, CONSTRAINT `buku_ditambah_oleh_foreign` FOREIGN KEY (`ditambah_oleh`) REFERENCES `users`(`id`) ON DELETE SET NULL ON UPDATE SET NULL )

timelineData.name: Query
timelineData.query: CREATE TABLE `jurnal_baca` ( `id` INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, `siswa_id` INT NOT NULL, `buku_id` INT NULL, `judul_buku` VARCHAR NOT NULL, `tanggal` DATE NOT NULL, `halaman_dari` INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, `halaman_sampai` INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, `jumlah_halaman` INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, `durasi_menit` INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, `ringkasan` TEXT NULL, `pesan_cerita` TEXT NULL, `rating` TINYINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 5, `perasaan` VARCHAR NULL DEFAULT '😊', `status` TEXT CHECK(`status` IN ('menunggu','terverifikasi','revisi')) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'menunggu', `catatan_guru` TEXT NULL, `diverifikasi_oleh` INT NULL, `diverifikasi_pada` DATETIME NULL, `created_at` DATETIME NULL, `updated_at` DATETIME NULL, CONSTRAINT `jurnal_baca_siswa_id_foreign` FOREIGN KEY (`siswa_id`) REFERENCES `users`(`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE, CONSTRAINT `jurnal_baca_buku_id_foreign` FOREIGN KEY (`buku_id`) REFERENCES `buku`(`id`) ON DELETE SET NULL ON UPDATE SET NULL, CONSTRAINT `jurnal_baca_diverifikasi_oleh_foreign` FOREIGN KEY (`diverifikasi_oleh`) REFERENCES `users`(`id`) ON DELETE SET NULL ON UPDATE SET NULL )

timelineData.name: Query
timelineData.query: CREATE TABLE `lencana` ( `id` INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, `nama` VARCHAR NOT NULL, `deskripsi` VARCHAR NULL, `ikon` VARCHAR NOT NULL DEFAULT '🏅', `syarat_tipe` TEXT CHECK(`syarat_tipe` IN ('total_buku','total_halaman','total_menit','streak','total_jurnal')) NOT NULL, `syarat_nilai` INT NOT NULL, `created_at` DATETIME NULL, `updated_at` DATETIME NULL )

timelineData.name: Query
timelineData.query: CREATE TABLE `user_lencana` ( `id` INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, `user_id` INT NOT NULL, `lencana_id` INT NOT NULL, `diraih_pada` DATETIME NULL, CONSTRAINT `user_lencana_user_id_foreign` FOREIGN KEY (`user_id`) REFERENCES `users`(`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE, CONSTRAINT `user_lencana_lencana_id_foreign` FOREIGN KEY (`lencana_id`) REFERENCES `lencana`(`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE )
